'''Aranya''' is a spider [[NPC]] found within a cave in {{Zone|The Wasteland}} on the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}.

== Quest ==
'''Aranya''' will make a deal with the player, stating that if they bring her a player with no [[Armor]] on, she will eat them, and in return the player will receive one {{Item|Chyme}}. The player can sacrifice themselves, but they will not receive any {{Item|Chyme}} for doing so. This can only be done once a week.

== Trivia ==
*If a player feeds another to '''Aranya''', it will result in the following death message: {{Rmt| &c☠ &7<player> was eaten by Aranya with help from <player 2>.}}
**If there is no player nearby, the message will instead read: {{Rmt| &c☠ &7<player> was eaten by Aranya.}}
